mission.title: Extraction
mission.description: Let Zion extract a Machine-groomed double, then strike at their extraction point through his trace.

npc.say: No problem. I'd walk you down there, but I'm expecting visitors any minute now. I hope you find who you're looking for.
Agent Pace is monitoring the operation.
The loss of Mr. Manohar is...regrettable. However, it serves a larger purpose.
I caution you against overconfidence. Moderate your emotional response.

phase.briefing:
{player}, the recruiting data we captured from Zion has made it possible for us to intercept and replace one of the humans they intend to extract from our pod system. This man's name is--or rather, was--Navin Manohar. Mr. Manohar has been terminated; a bluepill carefully groomed to resemble him has been put in his place. This man's mind has been partially overwritten by a special program.
We will now allow Zion to attempt to extract our version of Mr. Manohar from the Matrix. He has been placed in the original Manohar's apartment. I would like you to check on his status quickly. Zion's recruiting team plans to take him to their extraction point soon.

enter.say: That's Navin's apartment complex. I'm reading our blue's signal in the apartment. No sign of the Zion team yet; better make this quick, though. And remember to look incognito.

talk.say: Hello. Are you from... Oh, sorry. You must have the wrong apartment. If you call the number in the lobby, you can find whoever you're looking for in the automated index.

done.say: He seems to be holding up. Place looks all right... I'd say we're solid. Let's notify Gray.

phase.briefing: Good. You may await with Agent Pace the progress of Mr. Manohar at the hands of Zion's extraction team. She will notify you when your assistance is required for the next step of the operation.

enter.say: Got a few of our programs in there. That blond one's gotta be Pace...

talk.say:
Ah, {player}--one moment, per favore. The Zionites have given Navin the red pill. Their trace program is running, and is about to interface with our override program...
There! Our program has locked their trace process, and is proceeding back through their systems. You must reach the extraction point and eliminate the Zionites before they identify the threat and unplug their systems. Allan Allen and Hunter Leiden will assist you.

done.say: You heard the lady! Grab those guys and go!

objective.text: Lead Allan Allen and Hunter Leiden out of the area

phase.briefing: Eliminate the Zionites present, and obtain the data from their machine.

enter.say: Some weird signals bouncing around in there...but I'm reading our boy Navin, and some reds.
Groovy. Looks like we got there in time.

objective.text: Get the Data from the Computer

phase.briefing: Return the data to Agent Pace at our Tabor Park field office.

enter.say: Ah, I like that place. They really should invite us in more often.

talk.say:
Magnifico, {player}. The program implanted in our Navin, unwittingly triggered by Zion when they attempted to extract him, exploited a vulnerability in their trace program, gaining access to their systems which, during the critical portion of the extraction procedure, rely on data processed and returned by Zion's core server farm.
Although the interface to that system is protected, an analysis of the feedback data you retrieved should give us vital information on its location and configuration. {player}, this data could be the key to the Zion Mainframe.

objective.text: Give the Data to Agent Pace

talk.say: You have done very well, tesoro. If there is...anything I can do for you as System Liaison, do not hesitate to ask.

mission.finish:
While access to Zion's mainframe system would allow us to nullify their offensive capabilities almost immediately, obtaining such access is by no means assured. Further data is required.
Measurable progress against Zionite forces and systems continues to be made, however, and you have played no small part in this, {player}. The System benefits significantly from your continued support.
